## Phalanx Snoop (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
Female phalanx unchained rogue (snoop) 1  
LN Medium construct (aether, phalanx)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 9 (1d8+1)  
**Fort** +0, **Ref** +5, **Will** +1  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, **Immune** phalanx traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** dagger +3 (1d4+3/19–20) or short sword +3 (1d6+3/19-20) or short sword +1/+1 (1d6+3/19–20) or unarmed strike +3 (1d3+3)  
**Special Attacks** sneak attack +1d6  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 11, **Dex** 16, **Con** 10, **Int** 12, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 13  
**Feats** Improved Unarmed Strike, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +6, Bluff +6, Diplomacy +6 (+10 to gather information), Disable Device +6, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +6  
**Languages** Common, Erahthi  
**SQ** flashback (1/day), inspiration (1/day)  
**Combat Gear** repair kit (2); **Other Gear** armored longcoat, dagger, short sword (2), aetheric capacitor (5 au, see Appendix 1)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Assault Leader (Ex)** Once per day, when the phalanx snoop misses with an attack on a flanked opponent, she can designate a single ally who is also flanking the target that her attack missed. That ally can make a single melee attack against the opponent as an immediate action.  

 **Flashback (Su)** The phalanx snoop can tap into the lingering memories of their soul to gain abilities they do not normally possess. Once per day as a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity, the phalanx snoop may willingly experience a flashback to gain the benefit of a feat she doesn’t possess.
